title: Positivity of the sample count
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\varepsilon,\delta\in\mathbb Q$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon,\delta\le 1/2$. With $b(\delta)=\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/\delta\rceil\rceil$ and $m=\lceil 2b(\delta)/\varepsilon^2\rceil$, one has $m>0$.
